open_order_role_classification_summary.protective_stop: verified existing protective stops are allowed and required; they do not block scale-in by themselves

scale_in_eligibility_rule_summary: existing position must be long-only with quantity > 0 and below max_total_symbol_qty
existing verified protective-stop coverage must be sufficient before scale-in
no unresolved symbol incident may exist
no pending entry, pending exit, stale, unknown, or ambiguous open order may exist
fresh deterministic add-on signal is required
aggregate symbol quantity, symbol notional, portfolio exposure, and aggregate risk-at-stop must remain within caps
valid distinct scale-in ExecutionIntent is required before order submission
stop_policy_summary: Existing protective stops must remain intact. After an add-on fill, a separate protective stop for only the newly filled quantity must be submitted and verified through the normal stop path. Stop cancel/replace is not allowed in the scale-in path.
aggregate_protection_rule_summary: protected_quantity_sum >= open_position_quantity; under-protected symbols create an incident and block new risk.
duplicate_intent_prevention_summary: no duplicate active scale-in intent for the same symbol
no duplicate active scale-in intent for the same signal
no scale-in while an entry order is pending
no scale-in while a previous scale-in stop is unverified
reporting_statistics_rule_summary: record total symbol quantity after scale-in
record scale-in incidents and attribution notes when partial scale-in exists
fake_stub_test_coverage_summary: pending entry and ambiguous order blockers
symbol notional, portfolio exposure, and aggregate risk-at-stop caps
additive add-on stop representation with no cancel/replace
